sources.title: [2604.02097] LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce LatentUM, a novel unified model that represents all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating the need for pixel-space mediation between visual understanding and generation. This design naturally enables flexible interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation.

sources.title: LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning ...
sources.snippet: We present LatentUM, a unified model that embeds all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, such that generated visual tokens are directly interpretable by the model itself, eliminating the need for pixel-space mediation and naturally supporting flexible interleaved cross-modal reasoning.

sources.title: GitHub - SJTU-DENG-Lab/LatentUM
sources.snippet: LatentUM unifies all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, enabling interleaved cross-modal reasoning without pixel-space mediation. Unlike existing unified models that require pixel decoding as a bridge between understanding and generation, LatentUM reasons directly over its own generated visual content.
